ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.75:0.25 light-intensity (grey/white) to low-intensity (dark pigmentation/spots) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light grey base pigmentation across the fluke field; dark continuous banding along the trailing edges and distal tips; high-contrast focal black spots (diameter 10-30 pixels) scattered across both lobes; distinctive vertical chain of contiguous dark blobs located at the central axis descending from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 10% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the majority of the trailing edge; transition to higher-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve exhibiting convexity emerging from the notch, transitioning to a slight concavity along the mid-section, and ending in rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-on-light pixel clusters distributed semi-randomly; higher spatial density observed on the inner-half of the left lobe (viewer left).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated diagonal dark linear disruption visible on the mid-quadrant of the right lobe; low frequency across the total surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical, segmented chain of dark circular pigmentation/scarring extending from the median notch toward the peduncle, suggesting significant unique marking or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The vertical 'spine-like' alignment of dark spots at the fluke midline is a highly unique identifier not typical of standard mottling patterns.
